line.a_zaproszenie.text: What a beautiful sunset! Friends, tonight the fireflies will dance on the glade. You are all invited!

line.a_boje.text: But it's dark at night... I'm a little afraid of the dark.

line.a_latarenki.text: Don't worry! We'll take lanterns. Everyone gets one. I'll bring them right away!

line.a_dlugi.text: I've got the lanterns! Look what a long row. There's surely enough for everyone!

line.a_dlugi_rzad.text: Look: the lanterns lie in a long row, and we stand close together. There must be more lanterns!

line.a_sprawdzmy.text: A long row doesn't mean there are more. Let's check: let everyone take one lantern.

line.a_rozdaj.text: Drag the lanterns to the friends. Each one gets just one.

line.a_zabraklo.text: But there's no lantern left for me!

line.a_zabraklo.lisek.text: But there's no lantern left for me!

line.a_zabraklo.sowa.text: But there's no lantern left for me!

line.a_zabraklo.sarenka.text: But there's no lantern left for me!

line.a_wiecej.text: See? Someone has no lantern. There are more friends than lanterns. There are fewer lanterns.

line.a_oszukal.text: Oops! The long row fooled me. I'll run for one more!

line.a_tyle_samo.text: Now everyone has a lantern and nobody is left without. There are as many lanterns as there are of us.

line.a_chodzmy.text: With a lantern I'm not afraid. Let's go to the glade!

line.b_ciemno.text: Oh dear, it's got really dark...

line.b_puste.text: But our lanterns are empty. They don't shine!

line.b_swietliki.text: Look, fireflies! When you point to a lantern, a firefly flies into it and lights it up.

line.b_dotknij.text: Point to a lantern that isn't shining yet.

line.b_swieci.text: It's shining! Point to the next one.

line.b_jasno.text: It's so bright! I'm not afraid anymore.

line.b_zostaly.text: Look: every lantern has a firefly now, and some fireflies are still flying. There's no free lantern for them.

line.b_czego.text: Which are there more of: fireflies or lanterns?

line.b_czego_nie.text: The lanterns are all full, and fireflies are still flying. Which are more?

line.b_czego_nie.sowa.text: The lanterns are all full, and fireflies are still flying. Which are more?

line.b_wiecej_swietlikow.text: Yes, there are more fireflies and fewer lanterns! The ones without a lantern will fly off to dance.

line.c_zasady.text: Listen to the rules. While the music plays, we walk around. When the music stops, everyone jumps onto a stump.

line.c_zasady2.text: And whoever is too slow has no stump!

line.c_ty.text: You stop the music. Point to the green button whenever you like.

line.c_bez.text: Oh no, there's no stump left for me!

line.c_kogo.text: Are there more friends or more stumps?

line.c_kogo_nie.text: Every stump is taken and Fox is standing beside them. Which are more?

line.c_kogo_nie.sowa.text: Every stump is taken and Fox is standing beside them. Which are more?

line.c_wiecej_przyjaciol.text: Yes, there are more friends and fewer stumps. That's why Fox was left without one.

line.c_dolozmy.text: Let's add one more stump so everyone has one. Point to the stump at the side.

line.c_jeszcze_raz.text: Let's play again! Point to the button whenever you like.

line.c_tyle.text: There are as many friends as stumps.

line.c_sedzia.text: Now I'll be the referee, and the three of you play.

line.c_ostatni.text: Last round! Point to the button whenever you like.

line.c_pusty.text: One stump is free. Point to the one nobody is standing on.

line.c_pusty_nie.text: Someone is standing on that one. Look for the stump nobody is on.

line.c_pusty_nie.sarenka.text: Someone is standing on that one. Look for the stump nobody is on.

line.c_wiecej_pienkow.text: Yes, that stump is empty! Now there are more stumps and fewer players.

line.c_zyczenie.text: Make a wish. And now it's time to go home, for the sleepover!

line.p_start.text: Now some night games! You get a star for each one.

line.p_bez_pary.text: The lines join bunnies and carrots in pairs. Point to the bunny with no pair.

line.p_bez_pary_nie.text: There's a line from this bunny to a carrot. Look for the one with no line.

line.p_bez_pary_nie.sowa.text: There's a line from this bunny to a carrot. Look for the one with no line.

line.p_dlugi.text: The apples lie in a long row, and the pears close together. Which are more?

line.p_dlugi.sowa.text: The apples lie in a long row, and the pears close together. Which are more?

line.p_dlugi.sarenka.text: The apples lie in a long row, and the pears close together. Which are more?

line.p_dlugi_nie.text: Look at the pairs: one pear has no apple to pair with. Which are more?

line.p_dlugi_nie.sowa.text: Look at the pairs: one pear has no apple to pair with. Which are more?

line.p_daj.text: Each bunny wants one carrot. Drag one to each bunny.

line.p_daj.sowa.text: Each bunny wants one carrot. Drag one to each bunny.

line.p_daj.sarenka.text: Each bunny wants one carrot. Drag one to each bunny.

line.p_daj_ok.text: Every bunny has a carrot, and two are left over. There are more carrots than bunnies.

line.p_daj_ok.sowa.text: Every bunny has a carrot, and two are left over. There are more carrots than bunnies.

line.p_daj_ok.sarenka.text: Every bunny has a carrot, and two are left over. There are more carrots than bunnies.

line.p_baloniki.text: Each bunny can hold just one balloon, and there are too many balloons. Pop the extra ones.

line.p_baloniki_ok.text: Now each bunny has one balloon. There are as many.

line.p_myszki.text: Watch out, mice! Look carefully, they're about to hide.

line.p_myszki.sowa.text: Watch out, mice! Look carefully, they're about to hide.

line.p_myszki.sarenka.text: Watch out, mice! Look carefully, they're about to hide.

line.p_ktory_krzak.text: Behind which bush did more mice hide?

line.p_ktory_krzak.sowa.text: Behind which bush did more mice hide?

line.p_ktory_krzak.sarenka.text: Behind which bush did more mice hide?

line.p_krzak_nie.text: Fewer mice hid here. Try again.

line.p_krzak_nie.sowa.text: Fewer mice hid here. Try again.

line.p_krzak_nie.sarenka.text: Fewer mice hid here. Try again.

line.d_nocowanie.text: Welcome to the sleepover! After the night of the fireflies it's time to play in my home. Let's have a pillow fight!

line.d_druzyny.text: Squirrel and I are one team, and Owl and Deer are the other.

line.d_pary.text: I'll join the pillows in pairs: one of yours, one of ours.

line.d_zostaly.text: Yes, two of Fox's pillows have no pair. Fox's team has more, and ours has fewer.

line.d_przeloz.text: It's fair when both teams have as many. Drag one pillow over to the other side, to Owl and Deer.

line.d_przeloz_nie.text: Drag the pillow further, over to the other side.

line.d_tyle.text: Every pillow has a pair! Both teams have as many. Now it's fair.

line.d_bitwa.text: Then let's have a pillow fight!

line.d_dobranoc.text: And now it's time to sleep. Good night, friends.

line.d_rodzice.text: When you share with someone, lay things in pairs. If nothing is left without a pair, everyone has as many.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the glowing lantern from Owl. We got it on the night of the fireflies, when we checked where there was more and where there was less.

line.b_odlatuja.text: Look, they're flying away! They're going to the big clearing in the forest. That's where the dance will be.

line.b_mapa.text: I have a map of the forest. Two paths lead to the clearing. Which one shall we take?

line.b_ktora.text: Fireflies fly where there are more of them. Lead the lantern along the path where more fireflies glow.

line.b_ktora_nie.text: There are fewer fireflies by this path. Take the one with more.

line.b_tedy.text: Yes, this way, where there are more fireflies! Let's go!

line.b_taniec2.text: This is the fireflies' dance. This is what we came for.

line.e_chowany.text: I'm not afraid of the dark at all now. Let's play hide-and-seek! Owl looks for us, and we hide.

line.e_pomoz.text: Will you help me look? Listen carefully to who is calling.

line.p_bez_pary_ok.text: Yes, this bunny has no pair! There are more bunnies than carrots.

line.p_dlugi_ok.text: Yes, there are more pears! They lie close together, but one has no pair.

line.p_krzak_ok.text: Yes, more mice hid here! Look, they're coming out.

line.d_dlugi_rzad.text: Hey, your pillows lie in a long row! You have more. That's not fair!

line.d_sarenka.text: A long row doesn't mean there are more. Let's check it in pairs.

line.d_bez_pary.text: Point to a pillow that has no pair.

line.d_oj.text: Oops, the long row fooled me again!

line.d_spac.text: Phew, what fun! Time to sleep. Everyone needs a pillow under their head.

line.d_rozdaj.text: Lay one pillow on the rug for each of us.

line.d_dwie_zostaly.text: Everyone has a pillow, and two are left over. There are more pillows than us.

line.d_wypusc.text: And the fireflies in the lanterns want to go back to their friends. Point to each lantern to let them out.

line.d_leca.text: They're flying out of the window, to the dancing fireflies!

line.c_nowy.text: There's the new stump! Let's check if there's one for everyone now.

line.c_stop.text: Stop! Every player is on a stump. But look at the stumps.
